note: Revised from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the original describes the soldier and the alate and gives measurements of the lectotype soldier. Synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers, distribution records and taxonomic discussion have been omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule, antennae and labrum pale yellow; mandibles dark brown, slightly paler at the base; legs and body nearly white. Head moderately setose, body more densely so. Total body length 4.0–4.20 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, sides slightly narrowing posteriorly; frons gradually inclined anteriorly; length about one and a half times the width; length to mandibular base 1.25–1.30 mm, maximum width 0.88–0.90 mm. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus semicircular, delimited from the frons by a fine suture, setose. Labrum pentagonal, apex pointed; a pair of setae near the apex; length 0.20–0.25 mm, width 0.25 mm. Mandibles slender, about three-quarters of the head length, incurved in the apical third; inner margin finely serrate; length 0.925–0.95 mm, ratio of left mandible length to head length 0.731–0.74. Postmentum short, rod-shaped, waist slightly narrowed; length 0.63 mm, maximum width 0.33–0.38 mm, waist width 0.25 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin with a weak notch, posterior margin nearly straight; length 0.30 mm, width 0.58–0.60 mm. Mesonotum slightly narrower, metanotum as wide as the pronotum.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head nearly black; postclypeus dark brown; antennae brown; thorax, legs and abdomen also nearly black. Head and body densely setose. Total body length with wings 9.7–10.0 mm, without wings 4.8–5.9 mm. Head capsule subquadrate, sides nearly straight, slightly incurved at the compound eyes; cranial suture absent; length to the apex of the labrum 1.15–1.25 mm, to the mandibular base 0.85–0.90 mm, maximum width including the eyes 0.88–0.90 mm, interocular width 0.70 mm. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Compound eyes oval, narrowed anterolaterally, slightly protruding; lower margin at half their minor diameter; major diameter 0.23–0.25 mm, minor diameter 0.20 mm. Ocelli small, circular, separated from the compound eye by about their major diameter; major diameter 0.07–0.09 mm, minor diameter 0.04–0.06 mm, eye–ocellus distance 0.07–0.09 mm, ocellus–antenna distance 0.10–0.125 mm. Postclypeus convex, about half as long as wide; length 0.25–0.28 mm, width 0.48–0.52 mm. Pronotum flat, semicircular, anterior margin slightly raised; anterior margin weakly undulate with a shallow median notch, posterior margin nearly straight; length 0.48–0.50 mm, width 0.68 to 0.80 mm. Legs dark brown; apices of the tibiae slightly paler, fore tibia slightly swollen.
